actualPromptText:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: raw production game sprite-sheet capture for Aliens: Tantalus Frontier
Primary request: Regenerate from scratch ONE entirely new original fan-made/project bitmap sprite sheet for enemy-049-wild-boar-host, animation IDLE. PROJECT_ADAPTATION, canonExact=false, no licensed model sheet and no 1:1 claim.
Reference policy: no image input. Invent fresh pixels and poses; never trace, extract, reproduce or copy any existing sprite, licensed frame, toy, model sheet or official artwork.
Backdrop: one flat solid pure chroma magenta RGB(255,0,255), #FF00FF, across the entire canvas and every gap; no transparency, gradient, tonal variation, texture, floor, horizon, scenery or shadow.
Identity: the same living natural adult wild boar in all eight poses: compact low body, heavy forequarters, short neck, elongated wedge snout, one natural head/jaw, one lateral eye, exactly two dirty-ivory tusks, two small ears, exactly four short powerful mammalian legs, cloven hooves, short non-weapon tail and continuous coarse dorsal bristles. Earthy near-black/umber organic fur, gray-brown bristles, restrained warm snout/ear flesh, minor mud/scar wear, no equipment. Original project art only.
Exact sheet: exactly 4 columns by 2 rows and exactly eight individually authored chronological poses in strict row-major order, one boar per conceptual cell, no ninth pose, no borders or grid lines. Render every boar at about 70 percent of its cell width and keep that exact physical scale in all eight poses. Reserve at least 12 percent of every cell as empty magenta padding on LEFT and RIGHT and at least 10 percent on TOP and BOTTOM. No tail, hoof, bristle or snout may touch or cross any vertical quarter division, the horizontal half division or the canvas edge. Large obvious gutters separate all silhouettes.
View and consistency: complete whole body visible; strict orthographic gameplay side view facing RIGHT in all cells, snout/tusks right, no camera rotation or perspective change. Identical body length, shoulder height, anatomy, palette, detail and hoof ground line. Animate in place with no translation.
Motion: eight distinct grounded phases: 1 low alert settle; 2 gentle inhale; 3 subtle ear flick expressed only by the ear changing position, with absolutely no drawn motion line; 4 guarded sniff without stepping; 5 alert hold; 6 exhale; 7 ease toward start; 8 seamless near-neutral recovery. No duplicate or interpolation.
Continuity: Alien 3 animal-host continuity and the similarly named Kenner toy are exclusion/context guardrails only. This is a living natural boar host, not offspring or a canonical published creature design.
Avoid: xenomorph/biomechanical cues, dome, inner jaw, dorsal tubes, acid, slime, blade tail, armor, harness, saddle, fantasy anatomy, olive bony Kenner phenotype, pink domestic pig, humanoid pose, left/front-facing head, extra/missing limbs or tusks, duplicate, silhouette drift, cell-boundary contact, any text, symbol, action line, motion mark, accent stroke, UI, logo, watermark, checkerboard or scenery.

sourceRepairs.result: Eight complete poses recovered across raw cell boundaries, uniformly scaled with one reviewed uniform factor for this complete clip, root/support aligned, and recomposed into an exact opaque-magenta 1774x887 board.

Only declared foreground edge-spill RGB pixels were replaced from nearest original non-spill foreground references; silhouette topology and exact #FF00FF background were unchanged; residual count is zero.

spillThreshold.topology: foreground-only pixels within Chebyshev distance <= 8 px of exact opaque #FF00FF background

residualMatteHueThreshold.purpose: remove only edge pixels retaining matte-like R/B parity; russet/brown with low blue is excluded

deliveryVioletMatteThreshold.scope: all pre-existing foreground pixels in one nominal target cell
deliveryVioletMatteThreshold.basis: independent neutral-background audit of violet-magenta crest, belly, tail and leg contamination

spillThreshold.referenceSelection: nearest original foreground pixel that fails the strict magenta threshold, by expanding Chebyshev radius; within the first non-empty radius choose minimum squared Euclidean distance, then row-major y/x tie-break
spillThreshold.replacement: copy only the selected reference RGB onto the declared spill foreground pixel; never alter alpha/topology because the active sheet is opaque RGB
spillThreshold.fallback: if no source exists inside the local radius, choose the globally nearest original foreground pixel that fails the soft threshold using the same deterministic distance/y/x ordering
invariants: only pre-existing declared spill foreground pixels may change RGB
all exact #FF00FF background pixels must remain byte-identical
declared spill pixels after correction must equal zero
